narrative_purpose: Shows where the voltage actually lives: a hugely magnified slice of one pore wall inside a chimney, with crowded protons on one face and sparse on the other, and metal clusters studding the wall — the whole case for a vent origin in one picture.
subject: A greatly magnified cross-section through a single thin wall of porous mineral, drawn as a vertical band running down the middle of the frame, its surface irregular and spongy. On the left side of the wall a pale teal fluid holds only a scattering of small glowing round points, widely spaced. On the right side a darker fluid is densely packed with the same small glowing round points, many times more of them, crowded against the wall face. Embedded in the wall itself are perhaps eight tiny dark cubic clusters, each a compact cluster of small spheres, spaced along its length. A few of the crowded points on the right are shown part-way through narrow channels in the wall, mid-crossing toward the left.
scene: An extreme close view with no surrounding context, the two fluids filling the left and right thirds of the frame and the mineral wall between them, everything else dark.
camera: A flat straight-on cross-sectional view, as if looking directly into a cut face, no perspective.
light: Each small round point glows faintly amber from within; the mineral wall is lit only by that ambient glow from both sides, so it reads dark with softly lit edges. The left fluid is dimly teal-lit, the right fluid darker and denser.
palette: Teal-tinted fluid on the left, magenta-tinted darker fluid on the right, the wall in desaturated near-black stone, the crossing points in warm amber, the embedded clusters near-black with faint cool rims.
style: Painterly naturalist cross-section plate, hand-painted texture on the mineral, restrained and diagrammatic in layout but never flat vector.
detail_level: Crisp on the wall's spongy texture, the channels through it, and the embedded clusters; the two fluids kept simple and low-detail so the wall reads as the subject.
composition: Strong vertical symmetry with the wall as a central band, sparse points left and dense points right so the imbalance is immediately legible, dark uncluttered fluid at top and bottom of both sides to leave room for overlaid callouts.
consistency_notes: Same pale porous mineral as the chimney plates, seen far closer. The density difference between left and right must be obvious at a glance — roughly ten times as many points on the right — because that imbalance is the figure's whole content.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no chemical notation, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no neon UI glow, no cartoon or anime style, no flat vector infographic style, no sterile CAD rendering
